notes: Launches can no longer shoot almost straight up: the upward angle is soft-limited, with loft and long throws kept.
The invisible world edge no longer blows you up - touching it just ends the run cleanly.
Slower, fairer upgrades: score is still big, but banked upgrade credits are separate (about 20-30 good runs to max everything).
Skip chains no longer inflate wildly; the +10,000 (TEST) button is gone.
Five new cities: Downtown, Old Town, Suburbia, Industrial District and Resort Strip, plus the Grand Fortress and the Test Yard (training).
